places.quote: As it was almost noon, Joe and I held straight on to Miss Havisham’s house.
places.note: Fictional house named only by owner here; Satis House is its name in the novel, located in an unnamed town modelled on Rochester.

places.normalized: Pumblechook’s house, town of Rochester, Kent
places.quote: When we came to Pumblechook’s, my sister bounced in and left us.
places.note: Building named after its owner, Uncle Pumblechook; the town is not named in this passage.

places.quote: carrying a basket like the Great Seal of England in plaited Straw
places.note: Figure of speech comparing the basket to the Great Seal.
